text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
What is this!? Power is welling up from 
within...?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Between that voice and everything else, 
what's going on? I don't understand any of 
this.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Like I'd ever be scared, though... What's 
next? Bring it on, Central!
